sn47.8:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattaṃ vā nānaccayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa
sn47.8:1.2: ambilaggehipi tittakaggehipi kaṭukaggehipi madhuraggehipi khārikehipi akhārikehipi loṇikehipi aloṇikehipi.
sn47.8:2.1: sakho so bhikkhave bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattanimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti
sn47.8:2.2: idaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati imassa vā abhiharati imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati
sn47.8:2.3: ambilaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati ambilaggassa vā abhiharati ambilaggassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti ambilaggassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati tittakaggaṃ vā me ajja. kaṭukaggaṃ vā me ajja. madhuraggaṃ vā me ajja. khārikaṃ vā me ajja. akhārikaṃ vā me ajja. loṇikaṃ vā me ajja. aloṇikaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati aloṇikassa vā abhiharati aloṇikassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti aloṇikassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti.
sn47.8:3.1: sakho so bhikkhave bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo na ceva lābhī hoti acchādanassa na lābhī vettanassa na lābhī abhihārānaṃ.
sn47.8:3.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattanimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti.
sn47.8:3.4: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bālo abyatto akusalo bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.8:3.5: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ na samādhiyati upakkilesā na pahīyanti
sn47.8:3.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.8:3.10: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ na samādhiyati upakkilesā na pahīyanti
sn47.8:4.1: sakho so bhikkhave bālo abyatto akusalo bhikkhu na ceva lābhī hoti diṭṭheva dhamme sukhavihārānaṃ na lābhī satisampajaññassa.
sn47.8:4.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave bālo abyatto akusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti.
sn47.8:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattaṃ vā nānacayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa
sn47.8:5.2: ambilaggehipi tittakaggehipi kaṭukaggehipi madhuraggehipi khārikehipi akhārikehipi loṇikehipi aloṇikehipi.
sn47.8:6.1: sakho so bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattanimittaṃ uggaṇhāti
sn47.8:6.2: idaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati imassa vā abhiharati imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati
sn47.8:6.3: ambilaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati ambilaggassa vā abhiharati ambilaggassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti ambilaggassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati tittakaggaṃ vā me ajja. kaṭukaggaṃ vā me ajja. madhuraggaṃ vā me ajja. khārikaṃ vā me ajja. akhārikaṃ vā me ajja. loṇikaṃ vā me ajja. aloṇikaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati aloṇikassa vā abhiharati aloṇikassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti aloṇikassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti.
sn47.8:7.1: sakho so bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo lābhī ceva hoti acchādanassa lābhī vettanassa lābhī abhihārānaṃ.
sn47.8:7.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattanimittaṃ uggaṇhāti.
sn47.8:7.4: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.8:7.5: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ samādhiyati upakkilesā pahīyanti
sn47.8:7.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.8:7.10: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ samādhiyati upakkilesā pahīyanti
sn47.8:8.1: sakho so bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu lābhī ceva hoti diṭṭheva dhamme sukhavihārānaṃ lābhī satisampajaññassa.
sn47.8:8.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittaṃ uggaṇhātīti.
